verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents unauthenticated availability and pricing checks across hundreds of TLDs, plus a dryRun pre-flight availability check. A community user also reports the UI loads fast. Together these cover the instant-availability and multi-TLD parts of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of an anti-front-running policy (the 'no lookup-then-squat' promise), an explicit alternate-TLD or name suggestion feature, and independent hands-on confirmation of search speed and accuracy.
